Record Class ImuMountCheck.Inputs

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
frc.spectrumLib.localization.ImuMountCheck.Inputs
Record Components:
time - seconds
wheelsOk - every module connected, so the wheel velocity is real
vx - wheel-measured robot-relative velocity, m/s
vy - wheel-measured robot-relative velocity, m/s
omega - wheel-measured turn rate, rad/s
pigeonOk - Pigeon connected
pigeonYaw - radians
pigeonPitchDeg - mount-corrected
pigeonRollDeg - mount-corrected
pigeonAccelXG - g
pigeonAccelYG - g
imuPresent - onboard IMU read this loop
imuYaw - radians, after WPILib's mount orientation
imuAccelX - raw, m/s^2
imuAccelY - raw, m/s^2
imuAccelZ - raw, m/s^2
Enclosing class:
ImuMountCheck
public static record ImuMountCheck.Inputs(double time, boolean wheelsOk, double vx, double vy, double omega, boolean pigeonOk, double pigeonYaw, double pigeonPitchDeg, double pigeonRollDeg, double pigeonAccelXG, double pigeonAccelYG, boolean imuPresent, double imuYaw, double imuAccelX, double imuAccelY, double imuAccelZ) extends Record
One loop's readings.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:

      Returns:
